summary: Focus the reviewer surface on tangible material or equipment entities and executable QA activities. Dimensions, gauges, material, specification section, explicit quantity and other stated attributes are separated from item names. Test and inspection output exposes specification section and stated performer while excluding diagrams, shop drawings, schedules, ordinary submittals and administrative reports. Conflict and Missing Information are removed from current assembly, UI and readable exports without deleting legacy stored records. Fallback evidence excerpts begin at the supporting clause. The saved merged drawing/specification run is rebuilt offline as a three-sheet English workbook and matching JSON file.
decision_refs: User request on 2026-09-13 to correct material/test naming, retain properties/specification/quantity, reject keyword matches, expose test performer and specification section, and cancel Conflict/Missing
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested the naming/property corrections, QA performer and specification-section columns, exclusion of unrelated keyword matches, and removal of Conflict and Missing functionality.
known_limitations: The focused files are rebuilt from the saved historical run; no new paid model extraction was requested or performed.
A blank quantity or performer means the saved evidence did not provide a usable value; the exporter does not invent one.
The run remains PARTIAL and every item remains subject to human engineering review.
Legacy conflict and missing records remain in the untouched stored run and raw archive but are not generated by current assembly or exposed in the reviewer UI/readable export.
